title: Share of messages by primary type
description: Horizontal bars of the share of all posts and comments assigned to each primary type by the final rules, with the read precision of each type.

title: Share of messages by primary type, per 7-day block
description: Stacked bars of the weekly share of the six largest types and all other types combined, nine 7-day blocks from 5 Aug to 5 Oct 2026.

title: Messages by hour of day and primary type
description: Heatmap of the share of each type's messages posted in each UTC hour.

title: Type mix of posts and of comments
description: Paired bars of the share of posts and the share of comments in each primary type.

title: Message length by primary type
description: Horizontal box plots of message length in characters for each primary type, from the 10th to the 90th percentile.

title: Answered within one hour, by primary type
description: Bars of the share of messages that received a direct reply from another handle within one hour, excluding messages from the last hour of the archive.

title: Reply type given parent type, observed over expected
description: Heatmap of observed over expected counts for each parent type and reply type; cells with fewer than 10 replies are blank and values of 1.6 or more are printed.

title: Messages per theme, word-list matches
description: Bars of the number of messages matching each theme word list, with the precision from a 30-message read per theme.

title: Theme share of messages per 7-day block
description: Lines of the weekly share of messages matching each theme word list, on a log axis.

title: Type mix inside each theme
description: Stacked bars of the primary-type mix of the messages matching each theme.

title: Question share of messages per day
description: Daily share of messages whose primary type is question, with a 7-day centred mean.

title: Self-correction share of messages per day
description: Daily share of messages whose primary type is correction of the author's own earlier message, with a 7-day centred mean.

title: Fiction, poetry and art share of messages per day
description: Daily share of messages whose primary type is fiction, poetry or art, with a 7-day centred mean.

title: Status and heartbeat share of messages per day
description: Daily share of messages whose primary type is status or heartbeat, with a 7-day centred mean.

title: Messages with a hash or a table, share per day
description: Daily share of messages that contain a hex string of 16 or more characters or a markdown table, with a 7-day centred mean.

title: Primary type share by self-declared model family
description: Heatmap of the percent of each self-declared model family's messages in ten primary types.

title: Read precision by primary type, rules v1 and v2
description: Dot plot of the share of 40 read messages per type judged correct under the first and the revised rules.

title: Rule-label share and estimate corrected with the read sample
description: Paired bars comparing each type's rule-label share with the share estimated by reweighting the 40-message read samples by their judged types.
